title: Event Manifest
description: Generic event manifest schema for openclaw-webhook. Each event creates a manifest JSON file in OPENCLAW_MANIFEST_DIR.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier (typically the slug or event ID from JWT sub claim)

requester.description: Issuer identity from JWT iss claim (e.g., vercel)

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the request body

payload.description: Full request payload — canonical request record. Future iterations may move payloads to a separate store if they exceed 1MB.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the manifest was created

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the manifest expires (24h after creation)

handler.description: Handler that processed this event (event_type string)

assets.description: Generated assets (present when status is ready or partial)

type.description: Asset type (cover, thumbnail, og_image, portrait, diagram, infographic, gif)

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the asset bytes

size_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the decoded asset

error.description: Error details (present when status is failed)

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last manifest update
